ORDERED_STAGES.name: ACQUIRE_AND_AUTHENTICATE
actions: download final_rna_data.h5ad and final_atac_data.h5ad complete from Zenodo 20834804
verify md5 over the FULL bytes against f628b17aab355f80b912e3c715543cbd and b71589e0033e391e2fe97c1ae3928a7f
verify byte lengths 18439154935 and 14508702462
ORDERED_STAGES.fail_closed: STOP on any mismatch. The previous local ATAC copy failed truncated at 6,059,254,368 bytes while curl exited 0, so acquisition success is not evidence of completeness.

ORDERED_STAGES.name: PAIRING_QUALIFICATION
actions: C-1 cardinality and composite-key uniqueness in both files
C-2 donor agreement RNA.SampleID vs ATAC.sample_id over every composite-joined nucleus
C-3 cell-type agreement RNA.cell_type vs ATAC.cell_type
C-4 cohort agreement
C-5 raw-barcode collision audit across samples
ORDERED_STAGES.pass_rule: C-1 exact, C-2 zero mismatches, C-4 zero mismatches, C-5 reported, C-3 agreement >= 0.99
ORDERED_STAGES.fail_closed: STOP. Escalate for a depositor-provided pairing key. Do not execute correspondence on an asserted bridge.

ORDERED_STAGES.name: SCHEMA_AND_BUILD_PRECONDITIONS
actions: assert RNA .X integrality on a bounded sample and confirm the REVERSED layout (raw/X log-like)
assert ATAC .X integrality
verify var['gene_ids'] is Ensembl-formatted
verify the ATAC consensus peak build is hg38 using hg38 chromosome lengths taken from the authenticated hg19ToHg38 chain headers
recompute microglia totals, donor count and per-donor quantiles from the authenticated local bytes and compare against the committed schema receipt
ORDERED_STAGES.fail_closed: STOP on any failed assertion or on disagreement with the committed receipt.

ORDERED_STAGES.name: SUPPORT_AND_GEOMETRY_DIAGNOSTIC
actions: apply the symmetric measurement-support rules to linked edges and construct matched controls
report the full attrition funnel reconciling to 20,709
compute the 14 frozen features for linked and control pairs
run the out-of-span geometry diagnostic and emit its predeclared IN_SPAN / OUT_OF_SPAN verdict
ORDERED_STAGES.explicitly_not_computed_here: no RNA-ATAC correspondence value of any kind
ORDERED_STAGES.note: This stage is the last one that may be run before the design is audited. It opens no outcome.

ORDERED_STAGES.name: CORRESPONDENCE_EXECUTION
ORDERED_STAGES.requires: explicit authorisation after independent audit of the frozen design
actions: build within-donor RNA-only metacells
compute per-donor per-pair correspondence scores for linked and control arms
residualise through the unmodified continuous-adjustment estimator
compute the gene-balanced donor-averaged Delta and its donor cluster bootstrap interval
run all four anti-false-green controls
run every predeclared sensitivity arm

EXPECTED_RESULT_SCHEMA.fail_closed_requirement: The result artifact must not be emitted unless stages 0-3 all passed and are referenced by digest.

STOP_POINT_IN_FORCE.may_execute_now: nothing beyond stages 0-3, and only after the design is audited
